# mcp-server-template
> A simple tool to generate FastMCP 2.10+ compliant servers with stdio transport. - Simple command-line interface - Generates fully functional MCP servers - Uses stdio transport for MCP client compatibi...

This project includes automated llms.txt generation for AI accessibility.
